summary.text: Sonar is the lightweight model of Perplexity's Sonar API, launched on 21 January 2025 together with Sonar Pro and offered only through the API. Perplexity aimed it at companies that need quick question-and-answer features and included citations; Sonar Chat Completions support ended on 27 September 2026 and requests are being moved to its Agent API.

summary.text: Sonar Pro is the higher tier of Perplexity's Sonar API, made generally available to developers on 21 January 2025 alongside Sonar. Perplexity positions it for enterprises with in-depth, multi-step queries; it has a 200k context window, accepted image input from April 2025, and Sonar Chat Completions support ended on 27 September 2026.

summary.text: Sonar Deep Research is the research model of Perplexity's Sonar API, first listed in the API docs in late February 2025 and offered only through the API. Perplexity's docs say it runs dozens of searches over hundreds of sources and turns the findings into detailed reports; a reasoning_effort setting and an asynchronous API followed in May 2025.

summary.text: Sonar Reasoning Pro is a reasoning model in Perplexity's Sonar API, first listed in the API docs in early February 2025, that returns its chain of thought in the response. Perplexity's docs say it is powered by DeepSeek R1 and aimed at complex, multi-step topics; Perplexity recommended it in place of R1 1776 and Sonar Reasoning when those left the API.

Perplexity removed it from the API on 1 August 2025; a Llama 70B distilled version was also published.

summary.text: PPLX 27B is a language model that Perplexity post-trained from Qwen 3.8 27B, introduced on 25 August 2026 with Portable Computer, a version of Perplexity Computer that runs entirely on a local NVIDIA DGX Spark. It is available on the device to Pro and Max subscribers, and Perplexity trained it on synthetic tasks for its local Computer harness.

description.text: Perplexity offers an answer engine that gives cited answers, Perplexity Computer for multi-step research and workflow tasks, the Comet AI browser and an API platform for developers. It describes routing work across models from several providers and calls Sonar its in-house model, optimised for answer quality in its default search mode.
